strings.subtitle: — Bōkō fraqisteins —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Dragan jah fralētan ni ist. Brukei draugaknapu undarō.
strings.shred_button: F R A Q I S T E I
strings.ssd_warning: Wit! Ana SSD, ufar-mēljaþs wigs fraqistein ni wadjōþ in TRIM.
strings.confirm_text:
Bōka "{name}" ufar mēlida jah fraqistida wairþiþ.

Fāhan?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS anþara data-strauma (ADS) ni waurþjand.
• USN bōka ni hrainjada.
• Skadus-kōpja jah milhma-samwairþi
  (OneDrive jah swa) ni tēkanþ.
strings.status_full: Innата allata miþ nulim ufar mēlida. Aftra-giban ni mag — tōja nula ain þai saihwand.
strings.status_fast: Hafub, skal jah 4 MB strika ufar mēlida. Anþar ni tēkans, ak in gulpai, aftra-giban allis ni mag. In analaugnōs bōkōs brukei FULLS modu.
strings.status_empty: Bōka lāus was, ufar mēljan ni þarf. Fraqistida.
strings.error_permission: Ni mag du bōka galeiþan. In anþarai tōjai uslukana. Galūk jah aftra sōkei.
strings.error_not_found: Bōka ni bigitana. Airis fraqistida was.
strings.error_is_symlink: Sa ist bandi gasahteins. Bandjōs fraqistjan ni mag — mēlei-bōka waila þairhwisiþ.
strings.error_reparse: Sa ist staþs-bōka (OneDrive aiþþau swaleika). Data izōs in milhmam sind, ni ana diskam — hēr ni waiht fraqistjan.
strings.error_not_file: Sa ni bōka ist (kista aiþþau anþar). Fralēt bōka.
strings.error_hardlinks: Sa bōka anþara harda bandja habaiþ ({n} alla). Harda bandjōs ni haband haubiþ — all namna samaleika. Jabai fraqisteis þairh wiga, data ufar mēlida jah 32 baita skaidida, ak þata leifa þairh anþara bandja atgaggan mag. Fraqistei alla bandjōs frumist.
strings.error_compressed:
Bōka þraihana, analaugnida aiþþau þunnja. Miþ nulim ufar-mēleins fraqistein aldai data ni wadjōþ, unte NTFS anþarō þō habaiþ.

Afƕapi tōjan: taihsli-kli k → Swēsija → Fralētan → afƕap tōjō "Þraihan" aiþþau "Analaugnjan". þan SHREDDER aftra rinni.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} 𐍆𐌰𐌾𐌻𐍉𐍃 𐍆𐍂𐌰𐌵𐌹𐍃𐍄𐌾𐌰𐌽𐌳𐌰.

strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
𐌰𐍆𐍄𐌹𐌿𐌷 𐌰𐌻𐌻𐌰𐌽𐍃 {count} 𐍆𐌰𐌾𐌻𐌰𐌽𐍃 𐌿𐍃 𐌸𐌰𐌼𐌼𐌰 𐍂𐌰𐌹𐌳𐌰?

strings.hardlink_text:
𐍆𐌰𐌾𐌻𐌰 "{name}" 𐌷𐌰𐌱𐌰𐌹𐌸 𐌰𐌽𐌸𐌰𐍂𐍉𐍃 𐌷𐌰𐍂𐌳 𐌻𐌹𐌽𐌺𐌰𐌽𐍃 ({nlink} 𐌰𐌻𐌻𐍃).

𐌳𐌰𐍄𐌰 𐍆𐍂𐌰𐌵𐌹𐍃𐍄𐌾𐌰𐌽𐌳𐌰 𐍆𐌰𐌿𐍂 𐌰𐌻𐌻𐌰𐌽𐍃 𐌽𐌰𐌼𐌰𐌽𐍃.
𐌰𐌺𐌴𐌹 32 𐌱𐌰𐌹𐍄𐌰 𐌱𐌹𐌻𐌴𐌹𐌸𐌰𐌽𐌳 𐌿𐌽𐌳𐌰𐍂 𐌰𐌽𐌸𐌰𐍂𐌰𐌹𐌼 𐌽𐌰𐌼𐌰𐌼 𐌹𐌽 𐍆𐌰𐌻𐌳𐌰𐍂𐌰.
